final: WITH t AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, tr.type, tr.amount FROM trans tr JOIN account a ON a.account_id = tr.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE tr.date BETWEEN '1996-05-09' AND '1998-01-06'), r AS (SELECT region, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed, COUNT(*) AS n FROM t GROUP BY region) SELECT r.region, r.avg_signed, r.n, r.avg_signed / ov.o AS ratio FROM r CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS o FROM r) ov WHERE ov.o IS NOT NULL
